formal_question: Generate style fingerprints and propose Pils/Lager to Tripel transfers without worsening the specified above-threshold defects. The question does not prescribe thirty CDF guards, empirical boxes, a classifier pair, a success quota, or real brewing before mathematical delivery.
domain_definition: Main: modify only modeled fields annotated origin_paper=Yeast in attachment8 dictionary, excluding four protected coordinates. Lock all Hops/Malt/other fields and the four protected coordinates. Sensitivity: allow all modeled nonprotected fields, separately labeled; never automatically promote this to the main domain. These are statistical block controls, not independent causal brewing knobs.
local_support: For each source/domain choose five nearest measured Tripel profiles in the training robust-asinh RMS over mutable fields, before sensory predictions. Move mutable fields toward an arbitrary nonnegative convex combination of those five profiles, with a progress parameter in[.1,1]. Fixed fields stay at source. This searches a local multidimensional simplex, not a denser original single-anchor line grid. Interpolation is in supplied coordinates and is NOT literal volume blending or a physical recipe.
source_missingness: Use the official training imputer only for model coordinates, with every missing field recorded. Missing Diacetyl in beers119/28 receives the existing attachment8 zero upper-bound scenario, explicitly conditional on nonnegative concentration and fixed identity scale; do not call it a recovered raw measurement. Also report raw-missing versus zero-scenario baseline sensitivity.
chemical_main: Preserve all four protected supplied coordinates exactly, stronger than nonincreasing max(c/T-1,0) under a fixed compatible measurement mapping and fixed threshold. Do not uniformly exponentiate fields. Reference threshold ratios are supplementary and only computed for compatible positive reference pairs; zero/censored references, mapping conflicts and missing t2n threshold remain explicit unknowns.
structural_main: Require both existing fixed style classifiers predict Tripel, robust-asinh distance to observed Tripel center improves at least10%, and nearest measured-beer RMS stays within the95th percentile of global leave-one-beer-out nearest distances. Bounds and support are team modeling assumptions, not physical laws.
sensory_main: Require all five official integer grades nonincrease plus selected-uncalibrated P(rating>=1) nonincrease for the four targets with historical nonzero probability support. This is a data-based conservative proxy screen, not a chemical threshold or causal guarantee. Stale grade is only interface consistency, not safety evidence.
stale_main: Always mark true Stale nonworsening unestablished. Locking measured hop-origin coordinates and no grade change cannot prove Stale safety: age, storage, processing and matrix effects are unobserved. Every selected main spectrum is CONDITIONAL, never a fully certified five-defect success. Report calibrated/uncalibrated risk changes and operational assumptions separately.
selection: Within each source/domain choose minimum objective among main computational passes, tie by generation order. If none, keep a clearly labeled closest restricted proposal, not a passing transfer. Main and each sensitivity selection remain separate. No condition relaxed from observed pass counts.
search_ranking: Lexicographic structural violation count, sensory-main violation count, sum positive supported nonzero deltas, frozen objective. Do not optimize an unsupported Stale safety score.
stability: Ten paired style-stratified beer bootstrap refits of both style classifiers and original raw ET on fixed newly selected spectra; imputation fits resampled unique-beer occurrences with proper rating weights. No reselection, no original sigmoid reuse on new forests, no claim of intervention validation. Parameter sensitivity uses32 fixed .01-unit jitter draws around selected simplex parameters, not assay-error bounds.
generation: Reuse the existing300 interpolated Tripel/Kriek/Lambic spectra and existing generation comparison evidence, refresh their official-Q1 sensory outputs only. Preserve variance shrinkage/near-duplicate limitations and do not call these brewing measurements.
historical_control: Derive guard-specific counts from old113520 saved rows, do not refit or re-search the old grid. Replay three fixed grid points per source with the current official Q1 five-defect predictions and retain their comparison scope. Old zero result is for old thirty-guard scenario, not global infeasibility.
delivery: Implement, run, verify, report all11 source statuses and current model fingerprint, then push main and stop. No Q1 experimental model integration, no phase3 cleanup, no raw data or model binaries uploaded.
